title: cross-functional roadmap sync prep - Mar 2026
content:
Purpose / goals:
- Align Product (hosted + dedicated), Eng (serving runtime), and Applied ML on Q2 roadmap priorities that impact inference cost/latency and model adoption.
- Surface major risks, infra needs, and rollout constraints so we can finalize JIRA tickets and timeline.
- Decide on gating criteria for model upgrades (perf/quality/regression thresholds).

Attendees (ask to confirm):
- Evelyn Zhang (product) — facilitator
- Marco Ruiz (eng-serving-runtime) — runtime perf + batching lead
- Priya Nair (applied-ml) — model onboarding + evals
- Samir Desai (platform-engineering) — infra capacity/ops
- Jordan Lee (product-analytics) — metrics / telemetry
- Optional: Alice Moreno (SRE) for rollout / rollback policy

Pre-read (send 48h before)
- Link: confluence roadmap page (see linked artifacts)
- Short perf summary: RDW-1245 (kv-cache + prefix caching experiment) — perf delta + cost projection (Marco)
- Model quality check: RDW-1321 (Opt-Quant model ranking) — eval pass/fail (Priya)

Agenda (45m total)
1) 5m: quick context + objectives
2) 10m: Product priorities & target user impact (Evelyn)
   - Which features must ship in Q2? (Can we defer any?)
3) 10m: Eng constraints & perf tradeoffs (Marco)
   - Current capacity gaps, expected gains from batching/kv-cache changes
4) 10m: Applied ML: quality/regression risk + rollout plan (Priya)
   - Eval suite coverage, failing prompts, known edge cases
5) 5m: dependencies & infra timeline (Samir)
6) 5m: Decision & next steps (all)

Prep notes / talking points (scratchpad)
- Product: prioritize Hosted API features that drive retention (streaming + function-calling improvements). Need clear SLO targets (p95 latency < 250ms for short-chat workloads).
- Eng: Marco says we can hit p95 ~220ms on T4 equivalent if we enable continuous batching + small-kv cache but risk of higher memory usage on burst. Also need testing for seq length variance.
- Applied ML: Priya flags quantized model (4-bit) has ~2% BLEU-style drop on our eval set for multimodal prompts; may be acceptable if cost savings > 30%. Need canary workflow to measure UX regressions.
- Ops: Samir: capacity commit required by 2026-03-15 to reserve additional dedicated pools for Q2 launch. Otherwise timeline slips by ~3 weeks.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Can Product accept a small quality regression (0.5-2%) for embedding/qa models in exchange for 30% lower cost? (Decision needed in sync)
- Which eval thresholds are "blocking" vs "accept with rollback"? Need concrete numbers and who signs off.
- Is there a way to throttle memory for kv-cache during burst to avoid OOM? (Marco to propose config)
- Dependencies on infra (GPU reservations) — what is the exact cutover date to avoid delay? (Samir)

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Model regression discovered post-rollout -> Mitigation: tight canary (1% traffic) + automated rollback on quality delta > threshold; include manual sign-off for major models.
- Risk: Autoscaler instability with new batching -> Mitigation: staged rollout + feature flags + SRE runbook (Alice).
- Risk: Customer impact if latency spikes -> Mitigation: fallback routing to cheaper model variant and notify customer success.

Action items (owner — due)
- Priya: produce short eval summary table (metric delta vs baseline) for each candidate model variant, include example failing prompts — due 2026-03-05
- Marco: draft runtime config proposal (batching params, kv-cache limits, memory throttle idea) and perf projection spreadsheet — due 2026-03-04
- Samir: confirm capacity reservation timeline and options (monthly vs reserved) and cost estimate for Q2 burst — due 2026-03-06
- Evelyn: finalize product SLOs (p50/p95 targets) and decision guide (what regression % is acceptable) — due 2026-03-05
- Jordan: add telemetry dashboard mockups (latency by model/version, quality deltas by prompt set) and identify missing instrumentation — due 2026-03-08
- All: add relevant JIRA links/comments to RDW-1245 and RDW-1321 before the sync — due 2026-03-03 (ASAP)

Meeting logistics / notes to self
- 45 minutes only — keep decisions to top 3 items: SLO targets, model gating criteria, infra commit date.
- Ask Priya to call out two concrete example prompts where quantized model fails (helps Product decide).
- Prepare a 1-slide decision checklist (Evelyn) to show at the end with the three questions + proposed answers.

Post-sync follow-up (templates)
- Send summary email with decisions, JIRA updates, and owners (Evelyn) within 24h.
- Create a "canary checklist" in Confluence with steps for rollout/rollback and monitoring thresholds (Marco + Alice).

Notes / scratch fragments (keep for convenience)
- Consider small A/B with 10% traffic to measure real-world quality signal faster.
- If capacity reservation is missed, consider hybrid with cloud burst + e2e fallback to cheaper region.
- Possible blocker: KMS onboarding for Private customers might delay some deployments — flag to security if present.

Keywords for search: roadmap sync, model onboarding, kv-cache, batching, canary, quality regression, capacity reservation

Short version to paste into calendar invite:
Cross-functional roadmap sync — Product + Eng + Applied ML
Purpose: finalize Q2 roadmap gating for model upgrades and infra commits.
Duration: 45m
Pre-reads: RDW-1245, RDW-1321 (see linked artifacts)

-- end of doc --
